name: ExternalConceptProperties
title: Concept Properties for External Code Systems
description: The properties (and filter properties) that terminology servers in the tx ecosystem use with code systems that are not defined as CodeSystem resources: LOINC, SNOMED CT, NDC, ICD-11, ICF and UCUM. Each concept describes one property: which code system(s) it is used with (system), the code used for it in $lookup, $expand and ValueSet filters (propertyCode), the uri to use for it in a CodeSystem.property definition (uri), whether it is a concept property, a filter property or both (usage), the data type of its values (dataType), and the filter operators it supports (operator). This is the counterpart, for these code systems, of http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties: the standard properties that code system defines (status, inactive, notSelectable, parent, child, definition, etc.) are used with these code systems too, and are not repeated here. The concepts are grouped by code system; codes are the property code prefixed by the group code, since the same property code is used by more than one code system.

property.description: The canonical URL of a code system that the property is used with. Repeats when the property is used with more than one
The code of the property, as used in $lookup and $expand output, in the property parameter, and in ValueSet.compose.include.filter.property
The uri to use for the property in a CodeSystem.property definition (e.g. in a supplement), where one is defined
property (the property is reported on concepts), filter (the code is a filter property only) or both
The data type of the property's values (for usage = property or both)
A filter operator the property supports (http://hl7.org/fhir/filter-operator). Repeats
For a subproperty, the property (a concept in this code system) that it is a subproperty of
Notes on how the property is used
The concept is a grouper for the properties of a code system, not a property

concept.definition: Properties and filters used with LOINC (http://loinc.org): LOINC table properties, the Part (axis) relationships of the multi-axial model, answer list relationships, and mappings to other code systems
The status of the LOINC term as LOINC publishes it: ACTIVE, TRIAL, DISCOURAGED or DEPRECATED

property.valueString: Not the same as the standard status property (http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#status), which is also returned. The filter takes the LOINC status value

concept.definition: The broad type of the term's class: 1 = Laboratory class, 2 = Clinical class, 3 = Claims attachments, 4 = Surveys

property.valueString: Returned as the number (1-4), with a "description" part giving the name. Filters accept either the number or the name

concept.definition: Whether the term is meant to be used in an order, as an observation (result), or both: Order, Observation, Both or Subset
Example units of measure for the observation, as LOINC publishes them (not necessarily UCUM)
Example units of measure for the observation, as UCUM expressions
Y if units are required when the observation is reported, N otherwise
For a panel term, the kind of panel: Panel, Convenience group or Organizer
For an orderable term, the LOINC codes of the questions that should be asked when the order is placed (ask at order entry observations)
The copyright notice of the third party that owns the content of the term, for terms whose content is not owned by Regenstrief

property.valueString: LOINC publishes this column as EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE; FHIRsmith names the property Copyright. See also the copyright filter

concept.definition: Y if the term is valid as an HL7 attachment request (claims attachments), otherwise empty
Related names: a list of synonyms, abbreviations and keywords for the term, in a given language. Searchable keywords, not names suitable for display

property.valueString: May repeat, once per language; carries a language part

concept.definition: The class (category) of the term, e.g. CHEM, PULM, HEDIS

property.valueString: Returned as the class name (a string), with the Part code of the class in a "partCode" part. Filters match the class name or Part code

concept.definition: The first axis: the substance or entity being measured or observed (the analyte), as a LOINC Part code (LP...)
The second axis: the kind of property observed or measured (e.g. mass concentration, presence), as a LOINC Part code
The third axis: the interval of time over which the observation is made (e.g. Pt for a point in time, 24H), as a LOINC Part code
The fourth axis: the specimen, or thing upon which the observation is made (e.g. Ser/Plas, Urine, Patient), as a LOINC Part code
The fifth axis: the scale of the result - quantitative, ordinal, nominal, narrative or document (Qn, Ord, Nom, Nar, Doc...), as a LOINC Part code
The sixth (optional) axis: the method used to make the observation, where it matters, as a LOINC Part code
The adjustment part of the component (LOINC detailed model): how the reported value of the analyte has been adjusted or corrected, as a LOINC Part code

The challenge part of the component (LOINC detailed model): the challenge or provocation administered before the measurement (e.g. a dose of glucose) and the timing relative to it, as a LOINC Part code
The count part of the component (LOINC detailed model), as a LOINC Part code
The divisor of the component (LOINC detailed model): the analyte in the denominator, for a component that is a ratio, as a LOINC Part code
The gene part of the component (LOINC detailed model): the gene the analyte is, or is associated with, as a LOINC Part code
The suffix part of the component (LOINC detailed model), which qualifies the analyte (e.g. Ab, Ag, DNA), as a LOINC Part code

The super system part of the system axis (LOINC detailed model): whose specimen or which subject the observation is about, when it is not the patient (e.g. fetus, donor, blood product unit), as a LOINC Part code
The time modifier part of the time aspect (LOINC detailed model), qualifying the interval (e.g. mean, minimum, maximum), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC Document Ontology: the general structure of the document (e.g. Note, Report, Summary), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC Document Ontology: the role of the author of the document (e.g. Physician, Nursing), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC Document Ontology: the setting in which the service was provided (e.g. Hospital, Outpatient), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC Document Ontology: the subject matter domain of the document (e.g. Cardiology, Pathology), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC Document Ontology: the kind of service or activity the document describes (e.g. Consultation, History and physical), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the specific anatomic structure that is the focus of the imaging study, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the laterality (left, right, bilateral) of the anatomy imaged, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: whether laterality must be specified for the study, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the body region imaged (e.g. Chest, Abdomen), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the procedure (e.g. biopsy, drainage) that the imaging is guiding, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the approach (e.g. percutaneous) of the procedure the imaging is guiding, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the object (e.g. a catheter or device) placed or manipulated in the guided procedure, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: whether the study is performed as guidance for a procedure, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: a maneuver performed during the study (e.g. Valsalva, weight bearing), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the imaging modality (e.g. CT, MR, US, XR), as a LOINC Part code

property.valueString: LOINC's part link file gives the property as http://loinc.org/property/rad-modality-type; FHIRsmith names it rad-modality-modality-type

concept.definition: LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: a subtype of the modality (e.g. angiography, densitometry), as a LOINC Part code

property.valueString: LOINC's part link file gives the property as http://loinc.org/property/rad-modality-subtype; FHIRsmith names it rad-modality-modality-subtype

concept.definition: LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the route by which a pharmaceutical (e.g. contrast) is given, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: whether or which pharmaceutical (e.g. contrast agent) is given, e.g. W contrast IV, as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the reason for the exam, where it is part of the meaning of the term (e.g. screening), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the subject of the imaging, where it is not the patient (e.g. a specimen), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the timing of the images relative to an event (e.g. before and after contrast), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: how many views, or what kind of set of views, the study includes (e.g. 2 views, Single view), as a LOINC Part code
LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook: the view or projection (e.g. AP, lateral, oblique), as a LOINC Part code
For a LOINC term (question), the answer list (LL code) that holds its permitted answers. For an answer (LA code), the answer list(s) it is in

property.valueString: LOINC's own CodeSystem calls this property answer-list; FHIRsmith names it AnswerList (answer-list is the name of a filter)

concept.definition: For an answer list (LL code), an answer (LA code) in the list
For an answer list (LL code), the LOINC term (question) that it is the answer list for

property.valueString: As a filter, answers-for = X selects the answers (LA codes) in answer list X, or, if X is a LOINC term, the answers in the answer list(s) for that term; in is the union

concept.definition: Selects the answer lists (LL codes) that contain the given answer (LA code): the inverse of answers-for
Selects the answers in the given answer list (LL code)

property.valueString: Deprecated: an old tx.fhir.org name for answers-for = [answer list], supported for backwards compatibility only

concept.definition: Selects the codes that the given LOINC Part subsumes in the LOINC multi-axial hierarchy (ancestors include parents transitively; a Part is not its own ancestor). LOINC's implicit value sets (http://loinc.org/vs/[partcode]) are defined with this filter. in is the union over a list of Parts
Selects terms by who owns their content: LOINC (content owned by Regenstrief) or 3rdParty (terms with an external copyright notice)

Properties and filters used with SNOMED CT (http://snomed.info/sct) beyond the standard FHIR concept properties. In addition, every concept model attribute is a property in its own right (see sct-attribute)
The effectiveTime of the concept row in the RF2 concepts file (snapshot): the date the concept's current state was released
The SNOMED CT concept id of the module that the concept belongs to

property.valueString: FHIRsmith still accepts "module" as a name for this property in $lookup

concept.definition: True if the description logic definition of the concept includes sufficient conditions (the concept is fully defined); false if it is primitive

property.valueString: Returned for property=* or when asked for by name; not by default

concept.definition: The semantic tag of the concept: the text inside the last set of brackets of its active fully specified name (e.g. disorder, procedure)

property.valueString: Returned for property=* or when asked for by name; not by default

concept.definition: The necessary normal form expression of the concept or expression, with terms

property.valueString: Computed; returned only when asked for by name. Normal form expressions are not suitable for subsumption testing

concept.definition: The necessary normal form expression of the concept or expression, concept ids only

property.valueString: Computed; returned only when asked for by name

concept.definition: The LOINC code that the concept is equivalent to, from the LOINC Extension (alternate identifier scheme 30051010000102 |LOINC code identifier|)

Any SNOMED CT concept model attribute (a concept subsumed by 410662002 |Concept model attribute|) is a property, with the attribute's concept id as its code and http://snomed.info/id/[sctid] as its uri. The value is the target of the concept's defining relationship of that type (a code), or, for a concrete domain attribute, its concrete value (integer, decimal, string or boolean)

Returned with a code-display part giving the attribute name. 116680003 |Is a| is not reported this way: it is parent/child. Selects the concepts that match the given ECL (Expression Constraint Language) expression
Whether post-coordinated expressions are part of the value set: true or false
Selects concepts with an active description (fully specified name or synonym) whose whole term matches the regular expression, in the language of the request or the edition's default language
Selects concepts that have (true) or don't have (false) an alternate identifier in the identifier scheme whose concept id follows the colon, e.g. mapped:30051010000102 for LOINC codes

Properties and filters used with the US National Drug Code (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc). Most of these are named as openFDA names them, and come from the FDA NDC directory files and the openFDA downloads
The form of the code: product (a labeler-product code), 10-digit (a hyphenated package code, as the FDA publishes it) or 11-digit (the unhyphenated 5-4-2 form of a package code, as used in billing)
Selects products or packages: product | package
The FDA description of the code: for a product, its name; for a package, the package description (e.g. "30 TABLET in 1 BOTTLE")
The same package code in the other form: the 11-digit form of a 10-digit code, or the 10-digit (hyphenated) form of an 11-digit code

property.valueString: Not the standard (deprecated) synonym property: this is an alternate form of an NDC package code (see http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#alternateCode)

concept.definition: For a package, the NDC product code of the product it contains
The FDA product type (e.g. HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG, HUMAN OTC DRUG, VACCINE)
Whether the code is still listed in the FDA NDC directory: true or false

property.valueString: A string, not a boolean. The standard inactive property carries the same information, and is the one to filter on (inactive = true|false)

concept.definition: The proprietary (brand) name of the product
The nonproprietary (generic) name(s) of the product
The dosage form of the product (e.g. TABLET, FILM COATED)
The route(s) of administration of the product (e.g. ORAL)
The name of the labeler: the company that lists the product
The FDA marketing category of the product (e.g. NDA, ANDA, BLA, OTC MONOGRAPH FINAL). A package has its product's category
The id of the Structured Product Labeling (SPL) document version the product listing comes from
The set id of the Structured Product Labeling (SPL) document: stable across versions of the label (openFDA)
The FDA application number under which the product is marketed (e.g. NDA020702, ANDA076339), or the OTC monograph citation
An active ingredient of the product, with its strength and unit (e.g. ATORVASTATIN CALCIUM TRIHYDRATE 10 mg/1). Repeats, one per ingredient
A pharmacologic class of the product, with its kind in brackets: [EPC] established pharmacologic class, [MoA] mechanism of action, [PE] physiologic effect, [CS] chemical structure. Repeats
An established pharmacologic class of the product (openFDA). Repeats
A mechanism of action class of the product (openFDA). Repeats
A physiologic effect class of the product (openFDA). Repeats
A chemical structure class of the product (openFDA). Repeats
The DEA controlled substance schedule of the product (CI, CII, CIII, CIV, CV), if it has one
The date the product listing is certified through: the listing expires if not certified again by then
The FDA's reason for excluding the product or package from the current NDC directory (E = expired listing, I = inactivated, U = unfinished, D = delisted...), if it is excluded
For a package, the date it was first marketed
For a package, the date it stops (or stopped) being marketed
For a package, Y if it is a sample package, N if not
An RxNorm concept id (RXCUI) for the product (openFDA). Repeats
The FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier of an active ingredient of the product (openFDA). Repeats
A NDF-RT/MED-RT unique identifier for a pharmacologic class of the product (openFDA). Repeats
A Universal Product Code for the product (openFDA). Repeats
The name of the manufacturer, as openFDA gives it
Whether the labeler is the original packager of the product, rather than a repackager or relabeler (openFDA): true or false

Properties and filters used with ICD-11 - the MMS and ICF linearizations (http://id.who.int/icd/release/11/mms, .../icf) and the Foundation (http://id.who.int/icd/entity). Some apply only to the linearizations
The code as an entity: in the linearizations, the WHO entity id (the entity URI is the system url + '/' + the id); in the Foundation, the stable, unversioned WHO entity URI
The short classification code (e.g. 1A00), where the entity has one. For a postcoordinated expression, the expression in short code form
The kind of entity: chapter | block | window | category
The address of the entity's page in the WHO ICD-11 browser

property.valueString: Returned only when asked for by name

concept.definition: The Foundation entity this linearization entry came from, as a Coding in the Foundation (http://id.who.int/icd/entity)

property.valueString: Asked for as source.details, it also carries the Foundation entity's definition and parents as subproperties, and its designations

concept.definition: For a block, its block id
For a chapter or block, the range of classification codes it covers
For a postcoordinated expression, its root (stem) code

property.valueString: Only ever returned for a postcoordinated expression

concept.definition: A postcoordination axis of the code, with subproperties axis, required, allowMultipleValues and valueSet, and, for an expression, the value(s) on the axis. Repeats, once per axis

property.valueString: Has no value of its own: the subproperties carry the content. Without post-coordination-metadata=true only the axes that carry a value are described

concept.definition: Subproperty of postcoordination: the axis, as a code in the ICD-11 schema vocabulary (http://id.who.int/icd/schema)
Subproperty of postcoordination: whether the axis must be given a value
Subproperty of postcoordination: whether the axis may have more than one value - AllowAlways | NotAllowed | AllowedExceptFromSameBlock
Subproperty of postcoordination: the canonical URL of the ValueSet of the codes permitted on the axis
Subproperty of postcoordination: a code on the axis. Repeats. A value that is itself a cluster member carries its own postcoordination entries

Properties and filters used with UCUM (http://unitsofmeasure.org)
The canonical form of the unit: the unit reduced to UCUM base units (e.g. g for mg, or g/m3 for mg/dL)

property.valueString: Returned only when asked for (by name, or property=*). As a filter, canonical = X selects units whose canonical form is X
